title: Redox Active Hexanuclear Mixed Valence Dicationic Ce(III)/Ce(IV) Coordination Clusters

material_class.structural_family: mixed-valence μ4-oxo hexanuclear Ce(IV)2Ce(III)4 cluster with two dinuclear Ce(III) vanillinate-nitrate counteranions

synthesis.procedure: Aerobic reaction. H2L-H (0.8 mmol, 194 mg), o-vanillin (1.2 mmol, 182 mg) and Ce(NO3)3·6H2O (1.2 mmol, 520 mg) were stirred in MeCN (70 mL) for about 5 min to a clear orange solution. Et3N (3.20 mmol, 320 mg) was added dropwise over about 0.5 min. The light-yellow solution turned brown and was stirred for 2 h. Dark black rods formed after one week, were separated by decanting the mother liquor, washed with MeCN and dried in air. The same 2:3:3:8 H2L-R/o-vanillin/cerium nitrate/Et3N stoichiometry is described in the main text; changing the ratio to 2:6:5:11 in MeCN raises the yield. Aerial O2 is required for oxidation from lower-nuclearity intermediates to the Ce6 cluster.
synthesis.time: about 2 h stirring; crystallization over 1 week
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Dark black rods after one week; mother liquor decanted; crystals washed with MeCN and dried in air
synthesis.yield: 25% based on cerium (47% at reactant ratio 2:6:5:11 in MeCN)

properties.summary: DC susceptibility of 1^{2+}(X^{-})_{2} is reported to follow a χT versus T plot similar to that of the methyl analogue 2, for which eight Ce(III) ions are weakly antiferromagnetically coupled, with additional Stark-level depopulation and a possible Ce(IV) TIP contribution. Numerical χT values for 1 are referred to the SI and are not given in the main text.

material_class.structural_family: methyl-substituted mixed-valence μ4-oxo hexanuclear Ce(IV)2Ce(III)4 cluster with dinuclear Ce(III) counteranions; one deposition includes three MeCN

synthesis.procedure: Aerobic reaction. H2L-Me (0.8 mmol, 205 mg), o-vanillin (1.2 mmol, 182 mg) and Ce(NO3)3·6H2O (1.2 mmol, 520 mg) were stirred in MeCN (70 mL) for about 5 min to a clear orange solution. Et3N (3.20 mmol, 320 mg) was added dropwise. The solution turned brown and was stirred for 2 h. Dark black rods formed after one week, were washed with MeCN and dried in air. Main text uses the 2:3:3:8 molar mixture of H2L-R, val-H, cerium nitrate and Et3N; the 2:6:5:11 ratio in MeCN increases the yield.
synthesis.time: about 2 h stirring; crystallization over 1 week
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Dark black rods after one week; mother liquor decanted; crystals washed with MeCN and dried in air
synthesis.yield: 20% based on cerium (45% at reactant ratio 2:6:5:11 in MeCN)

properties.summary: Powder DC susceptibility from 300 to 5 K at 0.5 T shows χT near the value expected for eight uncoupled Ce(III) ions at room temperature, then a faster drop below 150 K to a low value at 5 K, assigned to weak antiferromagnetic coupling between Ce(III) ions together with Stark-level depopulation and possible Ce(IV) TIP.

material_class.structural_family: mixed-valence μ4-oxo hexanuclear Ce(IV)2Ce(III)4 cluster with nitrate counteranions

synthesis.procedure: Aerobic reaction in methanol. A 2:3:3:8 molar mixture of H2L-H, o-vanillin, Ce(NO3)3(H2O)4·2H2O and Et3N in MeOH for 2.5 h gives a dark brown solution; dark black blocks/hexagons were isolated in 75% yield. SI quantities: H2L-H (0.8 mmol, 194 mg), o-vanillin (1.2 mmol, 182 mg) and Ce(NO3)3·6H2O (1.2 mmol, 520 mg) in MeOH (70 mL), then Et3N (3.20 mmol, 320 mg). The mixture was stirred for 3 h to a black-brown solution. Diamond-shaped crystals formed after one week, were washed with methanol and dried in air. The reaction can be scaled fivefold in nearly 300 mL MeOH to give 2.21 g. An identical reaction under argon in oxygen-free methanol stays yellow, showing that aerial O2 is the oxidant. Using MeOH rather than MeCN selects nitrate rather than the dinuclear cerium anion as the counterion.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Diamond-shaped dark black crystals after one week; washed with methanol and dried in air

properties.summary: χT for the four Ce(III) ions falls from near the uncoupled value at 300 K to 1.55 cm3 K mol−1 at 5 K under 0.5 T, indicating weak antiferromagnetic Ce(III)–Ce(III) coupling through μ4-oxo and phenoxide bridges plus Stark-level depopulation. UV/Vis of 3 in DMF shows bands at 344 and 407 nm that decrease on heating with O2, with a new broad band near 700 nm. The dication also catalyzes TEMPO-free aerial oxidation of functionalized benzyl alcohols to benzaldehydes in DMF at 100 °C.

source_locations.location: Figure 6 and χT discussion; UV/Vis catalysis section

material_class.structural_family: further-oxidized mixed-valence hexanuclear Ce(IV)3Ce(III)3 methoxide cluster; not crystallized

synthesis.procedure: The same reactants as for 3 were used in half the volume of methanol. SI scale: H2L (4 mmol, 990 mg), o-vanillin (6 mmol, 913 mg) and Ce(NO3)3·6H2O (6 mmol, 2605 mg) in methanol (180 mL) were stirred about 5 min, then Et3N (16 mmol, 1630 mg) was added over 5 min. A greenish-brown slurry formed after 1.5 h and was stirred for 3 h. A brown crystalline powder separated after one week (2.41 g), was filtered, washed with methanol and dried in air. It does not form single crystals and is described as an oxidized derivative of 3.
synthesis.time: 1.5 h then 3 h stirring; isolation after 1 week
synthesis.vessel_or_method: 250 mL conical vial, concentrated methanol, aerobic
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Brown crystalline powder filtered after one week, washed with methanol and dried in air; does not crystallize for single-crystal diffraction

properties.summary: χT decreases from 2.40 cm3 K mol−1 at 300 K to 1.67 cm3 K mol−1 at 5 K, attributed to Stark-level depopulation and weak antiferromagnetic interactions between the remaining Ce(III) ions, similar to 3. Molar conductivity in MeCN is lower than that of dicationic 3, consistent with a monocation.

synthesis.procedure: Observed as a solution intermediate and structurally characterized from a slightly modified reaction of cerium(III) nitrate, H2L-H and o-vanillin under basic conditions. ESI-MS shows Ce4 species before the hexanuclear cluster appears after about 3 h; no separate quantified isolation procedure is given in the main text, and the SI synthetic procedures cover 1–4 rather than a dedicated preparation of 5.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Single crystals used for the structure in Figure 2; isolation conditions not quantified
